keyword: how many times has a 16 seed beat a 1 seed
claims: In the history of the men's NCAA tournament, a No. 16 seed has defeated a No. 1 seed only twice in 160 matchups.
UMBC (University of Maryland, Baltimore County) defeated Virginia 74-54 in 2018.
FDU (Fairleigh Dickinson University) defeated Purdue 63-58 in 2023.
KVUE notes that prior to 2018, No. 1 seeds were 135-0 against No. 16 seeds.
